methodology.summary: Codex filled the 12 PR75 ready shells from review-safe checked-in summaries only. This is provisional semantic review, not human validation.
methodology.pass_1_delta_reader: Identify candidate action, threshold, sequence, evidence-gate, stop-rule, written-term, scope, overclaim, or user-question changes.
methodology.pass_2_skeptical_reader: Look for no-op prose, caveat bloat, lost value, likely-action over-inference, noisy friction, and insufficient safe context.
methodology.pass_3_conservative_consolidation: Prefer partial or inconclusive reads where the safe source is compressed; keep human follow-up questions specific.
